title: Refunds
answer: You can request a refund within 30 days from Orders > Request refund. Refunds reach your card in 5 to 10 business days.

title: Reset your password
answer: Choose Forgot password on the sign-in page. We email a reset link that expires after 1 hour.

title: Shipping times
answer: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. Your tracking link is in the order confirmation email.

title: Cancel a subscription
answer: Cancel any time from Settings > Billing > Cancel plan. You keep access until the end of the billing period.
